title: Cosmic Eye of the Dreamer
description: A massive stylized green eye dominates the surreal night sky, its iris containing a silhouetted female figure. Below are dark jagged mountains, while a colorful female profile with swirling psychedelic hair appears in the bottom right as a purple orb drips above.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a giant stylized green eye floating in a starry night sky, intricate decorative patterns on the eyelid, a female silhouette standing inside the iris, dark jagged mountains below, a colorful female profile with swirling green and purple hair in the bottom right corner, a melting purple orb dripping from the top right, flowing ribbons of red and orange across the sky, feathers floating in the air, mystical and dreamlike atmosphere
